subject: Vendor registration: PO template, split-invoice cadence & VAT routing
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@acme-payments.com>, accounts@acme-payments.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor registration: PO template, split-invoice cadence & VAT routing

Hi Carlos / Acme AP team,

Thanks for the warm intro — excited to get Redwood set up as a vendor in your system. To speed things along we attached our standard AP onboarding packet plus a quarterly PO template that matches the retainer structure we discussed. A few items we need you to confirm before we begin sending invoices: 

- PO acceptance: Can you confirm whether Acme requires a single PO per quarter, or a one-off master PO with multiple invoice line items?
- Split invoicing: If you accept split invoices against a single PO, do you require a sequence number or invoice-period suffix on the invoice PDF filename?
- VAT routing: For services delivered from Redwood US to Acme US/EU entities, which remit entity should we list on the invoice? Please confirm the invoice remit name and VAT/Tax ID you want on the line.
- E-invoice/portal: Do you prefer invoices uploaded via your vendor portal (accounts@acme-payments.com inbox) or sent to AP SFTP? If portal, please share API/CSV sample or portal invite link.

Attached: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Acme.pdf (vendor packet) and Quarterly_PO_Template.xlsx.

Proposed next steps: once you confirm PO format and remit details, we will:
1) populate and return the signed vendor packet;
2) submit the first invoice (Quarter 2 retainer) using the agreed filename and VAT fields;
3) validate receipt in your portal and set payment terms in your system.

If helpful, we can jump on a 20-minute call with your AP contact to walk through the template.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

---
Attachments referenced above: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Acme.pdf (pdf), Quarterly_PO_Template.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@acme-payments.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts@acme-payments.com
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 10:15:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendor registration: PO template, split-invoice cadence & VAT routing

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the packet — quick answers below so you can prepare the first invoice: 

- PO approach: We prefer a single master PO per fiscal quarter (one PO covers all monthlies), but we also accept individual POs per invoice if your billing system requires it. For Redwood, a master quarterly PO will work fine.
- Split invoices: We allow split invoices against the same PO. Please include an invoice-period suffix in the file name using YYYYMM (e.g., RW-INVOICE-202606.pdf). Our portal will automatically match by PO number + invoice filename.
- Remit/VAT: For US-to-US services list: Acme Payments, Inc. (Remit: Acme Payments, Inc.; Tax ID: 12-3456789). For any EU-entity billing please route to Acme Payments EU B.V. — I'll attach the EU remit profile.
- Portal: We prefer vendor portal uploads. I invited "redwood@acme-portal" to the portal; you should have an invite link in a separate email. If you don't see it, we can provision SFTP access instead.

I attached the EU remit profile separately (sent by our Treasury team). Let me know if you want a short call; otherwise confirm and submit the onboarding packet and first invoice file name.

Best,
Carlos Mendez
Senior AP Supervisor
Acme Payments
carlos.mendez@acme-payments.com
+1 (212) 555-7890

---
Attachment: Acme_EU_Remits.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@acme-payments.com>, accounts@acme-payments.com
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 12:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration: PO template, split-invoice cadence & VAT routing

Thanks Carlos — that answers most of it. Quick internal notes before we upload: 

- We will use a master PO per quarter. Payroll/finance prefers to keep each invoice as a separate PDF (one per month) using the YYYYMM suffix Carlos requested.
- Invoice filename convention: RW-ACME-PO-<PO#>-YYYYMM.pdf (e.g., RW-ACME-PO-98765-202606.pdf). Laura, can you add that filename pattern into our billing automation so the portal matching is deterministic?
- Remit/VAT: We'll use Acme Payments, Inc. for US invoices (Tax ID in Carlos's note). For EU work, Treasury will route to the EU remit entity and include VAT handling; we'll copy the EU remit profile into the onboarding packet.
- Portal upload: Jasmine, when you upload the first invoice please use the vendor portal (use the invite sent to redwood@acme-portal). If invite missing, switch to accounts@acme-payments.com inbox and mark the subject line: "Vendor Invoice: PO <PO#> - RW" so their parser picks it up.

Action items:
- Jasmine: update the onboarding packet with the filename convention and US remit details, then upload the first June invoice by 2026-06-03.
- Laura: update billing automation and webhook metadata mapping for portal file name matching.
- Marissa: I will confirm internal GL mapping and payment term tags (Net45 default unless Acme requires Net30).

Thanks — should be straightforward to finalize this week.

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@acme-payments.com>, accounts@acme-payments.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2026 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration: PO template, split-invoice cadence & VAT routing

Thanks everyone — quick confirmation from our side: 

- I updated the onboarding packet with the filename rule and US remit details and attached the signed packet to this thread (see Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Acme.pdf).
- First invoice will be submitted to the vendor portal on 2026-06-01 as RW-ACME-PO-98765-202606.pdf and will reference PO 98765 (master quarterly PO).
- Payment terms: we will submit Net45 invoices unless Acme formally asks for Net30; Marissa will flag if Finance needs Net30 for this account.

If no further changes, I'll proceed with the portal upload and ping once the file is accepted. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Jasmine Liu
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
